-- @prop gear none
-- Elder Mu greets the Player at the sect gate, once.
local spoken = true
function on_tick()
  if spoken then return end
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(player)
  local dx, dz = px - self.x, pz - self.z
  if dx * dx + dz * dz > 36 then return end
  spoken = true
  start(function()
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Welcome, disciple. Qi is the river of the martial world.")
    wait(4)
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Hold N and sit still to gather it. Then press B with a Breakthrough Pill.")
    wait(5)
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Bandits in the valley have taken the road. Clear them, then face the guardian at the shrine.")
  end)
end

function on_start()
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
end

Script.source:
-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if n:find("^Bandit") then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  if alert_left <= 0 and (world.name(self.id) or ""):find("^Bandit") then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(1 + 0.3 * phase, 1 + 0.08 * phase, -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-lang", LANG)
end

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end
local function silver() return inventory.count(me(), "Silver") end
local function price_of(name, override) return math.max(1, math.floor((override or ITEMS[name].buy or 1) * (1 - discount) + 0.5)) end
local function say(text) note = text note_left = 3 end

local function needs_text(needs)
  local parts = {}
  for name, n in pairs(needs) do parts[#parts + 1] = n .. " " .. (name == "Silver" and "silver" or name) end
  table.sort(parts)
  return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end
local function has_all(needs)
  for name, n in pairs(needs) do if inventory.count(me(), name) < n then return false end end
  return true
end

local function rows_buy()
  local rows = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(STOCK) do
    local name, item = entry[1], ITEMS[entry[1]]
    local count = entry.count or 1
    local price = price_of(name, entry[2] and entry[2] * count or nil) * (entry[2] and 1 or count)
    local state = "ok"
    if entry.rep and rep_good < entry.rep then state = "locked" end
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. (count > 1 and (" x" .. count) or ""), icon = item.icon, right = state == "locked" and ("needs standing " .. entry.rep) or (price .. " silver"), state = state, detail = item.desc, price = price, count = count }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_sell()

  for name in pairs(inventory.list(me())) do names[#names + 1] = name end
  table.sort(names)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local item = ITEMS[name]
    local have = inventory.count(me(), name)
    if item and (item.sell or 0) > 0 and have > 0 and inventory.equipped(me(), GEAR_SLOT[name] or "none") ~= name then
      rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. (have > 1 and (" x" .. have) or ""), icon = item.icon, right = item.sell .. " silver", state = "ok", detail = item.desc }
    end
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_back()
  local rows = {}
  for i, b in ipairs(buyback) do
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = tostring(i), name = b.name .. (b.n > 1 and (" x" .. b.n) or ""), icon = ITEMS[b.name].icon, right = b.price .. " silver", state = "ok", detail = "Buy back what you sold." }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_alchemy()
  local rows = {}
  for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = r.id, name = r.out, icon = ITEMS[r.out].icon, right = needs_text(r.needs), state = has_all(r.needs) and "ok" or "locked", detail = ITEMS[r.out].desc }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_forge()
  local rows = {}
  for name, up in pairs(GEAR_UP) do
    if inventory.count(me(), name) > 0 then
      local needs = { ["Iron Ore"] = up.ore, Silver = up.silver }
      if up.stone > 0 then needs["Spirit Stone"] = up.stone end
      rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. " > " .. up.to, icon = ITEMS[up.to].icon, right = needs_text(needs), state = has_all(needs) and "ok" or "locked", detail = ITEMS[up.to].desc }
    end
  end
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
  return rows
end

local function rows_now()
  if mode == "merchant" then return tab == 1 and rows_buy() or tab == 2 and rows_sell() or rows_back() end
  if mode == "alchemy" then return rows_alchemy() end
  return rows_forge()
end

local TITLES = { merchant = "Merchant Lin", alchemy = "Alchemy furnace", forge = "Anvil" }

local function show()
  if not mode then return end
  local rows = rows_now()
  local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#rows / PER_PAGE))
  page = math.max(1, math.min(page, pages))
  local lines = { TITLES[mode], note or (silver() .. " silver") }
  if mode == "merchant" then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("tabs|%d|Buy|Sell|Buy back", tab) end
  for i = (page - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1, math.min(#rows, page * PER_PAGE) do
    local r = rows[i]
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("row|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s", r.id, r.name, r.icon, r.right, r.state, r.detail)
  end
  if pages > 1 then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("page|%d|%d", page, pages) end
  ui.set_text("Shop window", table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

local function open(kind)
  mode, tab, page, note = kind, 1, 1, nil
  ui.open("Shop window")
  show()
end

local function close()
  mode = nil
  ui.close("Shop window")
end

local function add_item(name, n)
  return inventory.add(me(), name, n)
end

local function pick(id)
  if mode == "merchant" then
    if tab == 1 then
      for _, r in ipairs(rows_buy()) do
        if r.id == id then
          if silver() < r.price then say("You cannot afford that.")
          elseif inventory.space(me(), id) < r.count then say("You cannot carry more.")
          else
            inventory.remove(me(), "Silver", r.price)
            add_item(id, r.count)
            sound.play("coin handle")
            say("Bought " .. id .. ".")
          end
        end
      end
    elseif tab == 2 then
      local have = inventory.count(me(), id)
      local item = ITEMS[id]
      if item and have > 0 then
        local n = math.min(have, id == "Arrow" and 10 or 1)
        inventory.remove(me(), id, n)
        inventory.add(me(), "Silver", item.sell * n)
        table.insert(buyback, 1, { name = id, n = n, price = item.sell * n * 2 })
        if #buyback > 8 then table.remove(buyback) end
        sound.play("coin handle")
        say("Sold " .. id .. " for " .. item.sell * n .. ".")
      end
    else
      local b = buyback[tonumber(id)]
      if b then
        if silver() < b.price then say("You cannot afford that.")
        else
          inventory.remove(me(), "Silver", b.price)
          add_item(b.name, b.n)
          table.remove(buyback, tonumber(id))
          sound.play("coin handle")
          say("Bought back " .. b.name .. ".")
        end
      end
    end
  elseif mode == "alchemy" then
    for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
      if r.id == id then
        if not has_all(r.needs) then say("You lack the ingredients.")
        elseif inventory.space(me(), r.out) < 1 then say("You cannot carry more.")
        else
          for name, n in pairs(r.needs) do inventory.remove(me(), name, n) end
          add_item(r.out, 1)
          sound.play("force field")
          say("The furnace glows: " .. r.out .. ".")
          world.send(world.find("Sect"), "brewed", r.out)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif mode == "forge" then
    local up = GEAR_UP[id]
    if up and inventory.count(me(), id) > 0 then
      local needs = { ["Iron Ore"] = up.ore, Silver = up.silver }
      if up.stone > 0 then needs["Spirit Stone"] = up.stone end
      if not has_all(needs) then say("You lack the materials.")
      else
        local slot = GEAR_SLOT[id]
        local worn = slot and inventory.equipped(me(), slot) == id
        if worn then inventory.unequip(me(), slot) end
        for name, n in pairs(needs) do inventory.remove(me(), name, n) end
        inventory.remove(me(), id, 1)
        add_item(up.to, 1)
        if worn then inventory.equip(me(), slot, up.to) end
        sound.play("metal hit")
        say(id .. " becomes " .. up.to .. ".")
        world.send(world.find("Sect"), "forged", up.to)
      end
    end
  end
  show()
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  if name == "open" then open(tostring(value))
  elseif name == "discount" then discount = tonumber(value) or 0
  elseif name == "standing" then rep_good = tonumber(value) or 0 end
end

function on_ui(name, value)
  if name ~= "Shop window" then return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if value == "close" then close()
  elseif value:sub(1, 5) == "pick:" then pick(value:sub(6))
  elseif value:sub(1, 4) == "tab:" then tab = tonumber(value:sub(5)) or 1 page = 1 show()
  elseif value:sub(1, 5) == "page:" then page = page + (tonumber(value:sub(6)) or 0) show() end
end

function on_start()
  me()
  ui.set_text("Inventory", inventory_notes())
end

function on_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  if note_left > 0 then
    note_left = note_left - dt
    if note_left <= 0 then note = nil if mode then show() end end
  end
  -- The quick-slot row: consumables on keys with their counts.
  if clock >= 0.4 and me() then
    clock = 0
    local function row(key, icon, name, label) return string.format("%s|%s|%d|%s", key, icon, inventory.count(player, name), label) end
    ui.set_text("Quick slots", table.concat({

      row("9", "scroll", "Ward Talisman", "Ward Talisman"),
      row("Y", "bullet", "Arrow", "Arrows"),
    }, "\n"))
  end
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-lang", LANG)
end

-- Conversation plumbing shared by the scripts that talk to the Player (the scene builder places it in front of them):
-- the Dialogue widget shows what is said and numbered choices; keys 1 to 3 pick one. While a conversation is open the
-- Player script sets its mana aside (the number keys are skill keys too).
TALK_RANGE = 3.6
talking = nil            -- the name of whoever is being talked to
local talk_player

function player_id() talk_player = talk_player or world.find("Player") return talk_player end

-- A tap counts once even when a slow frame runs several ticks.
local last_tap, tap_clock = {}, 0
function tap_tick(dt) tap_clock = tap_clock + dt end
function tapped(action)
  if input.action_pressed(action) and tap_clock - (last_tap[action] or -1) > 0.3 then
    last_tap[action] = tap_clock
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function say(speaker, line, choices)
  local text = speaker .. ": " .. line
  for _, c in ipairs(choices or {}) do text = text .. "\n> " .. c end
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", text)
end

function end_talk()
  if talking then
    talking = nil
    ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
    local p = player_id()
    if p then world.send(p, "talk", 0) end
  end
end

function start_talk(name)
  talking = name
  local p = player_id()
  if p then world.send(p, "talk", 1) end
end

-- The distance from the Player to a named entity, or nil.
function distance_to(name)
  local p, id = player_id(), world.find(name)
  if not p or not id then return nil end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(p)
  local x, _, z = world.position(id)
  return math.sqrt((px - x) ^ 2 + (pz - z) ^ 2)
end

-- The nearest of these names within talking range, or nil.
function nearest_within(names, range)
  local best, best_d = nil, (range or TALK_RANGE)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local d = distance_to(name)
    if d and d < best_d then best, best_d = name, d end
  end
  return best
end

-- Walking away ends a conversation; E ends it too. Returns the key (1 to 3) the Player picked, if any.
function talk_poll()
  if not talking then return nil end
  local d = distance_to(talking)
  if not d or d > TALK_RANGE + 2.5 then end_talk() return nil end
  if tapped("interact") then end_talk() return nil end
  for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
    if input.pressed(key) and tap_clock - (last_tap.pick or -1) > 0.3 then
      last_tap.pick = tap_clock
      return n
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function load_state()
  local text = save.get("azure-cloud-sect-sect")
  if not text or text == "" then return end
  local f = {}
  for k, v in text:gmatch("(%w+)=([^;]*)") do f[k] = v end
  contribution = tonumber(f.contrib) or 0
  rep.sect, rep.village, rep.bandits = tonumber(f.rs) or 0, tonumber(f.rv) or 0, tonumber(f.rb) or 0
  kills = tonumber(f.kills) or 0
  completed = tonumber(f.done_m) or 0
  for id in (f.codex or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do unlocked[id] = true codex_order[#codex_order + 1] = id end
  for id in (f.done or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do done[id] = true end
  for id in (f.tips or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do tips_seen[id] = true end
  local o = {}
  for i in (f.offer or ""):gmatch("%d+") do o[#o + 1] = tonumber(i) end
  if #o == 3 then offer = o end
  for id, n in (f.active or ""):gmatch("(%w+):(%d+)") do active[id] = tonumber(n) end
end

-- ---- The mission board
local function mission(i) return MISSIONS[offer[i]] end
local function progress_of(m)
  if m.kind == "bring" then return math.min(m.n, inventory.count(me(), m.item)) end
  return math.min(m.n, active[m.id] or 0)
end
local function board_choices()
  local choices = {}
  for i = 1, 3 do
    local m = mission(i)
    if active[m.id] ~= nil then
      choices[i] = progress_of(m) >= m.n and (m.name .. ": hand in (" .. m.silver .. " silver)") or (m.name .. ": " .. progress_of(m) .. "/" .. m.n)
    else
      choices[i] = m.name .. ": " .. m.text
    end
  end
  return choices
end
local function board_render(note)
  local name, nxt = rank_of()
  say("Mission board", note or (name .. ", " .. contribution .. " contribution" .. (nxt and (" (next rank at " .. nxt[2] .. ")") or "") .. "."), board_choices())
end
local function replace_offer(slot)
  local shown = {}
  for _, i in ipairs(offer) do shown[i] = true end
  local pool = {}
  for i, m in ipairs(MISSIONS) do if not shown[i] and active[m.id] == nil then pool[#pool + 1] = i end end
  if #pool > 0 then offer[slot] = pool[math.random(#pool)] end
end
local function board_choose(n)
  local m = mission(n)
  if not m then return end
  if active[m.id] == nil then
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(active) do count = count + 1 end
    if count >= 2 then board_render("You may hold two missions at once.") return end
    active[m.id] = 0
    sound.play("book open")
    persist()
    board_render("Accepted: " .. m.name .. ".")
  elseif progress_of(m) >= m.n then
    if m.kind == "bring" then inventory.remove(me(), m.item, m.n) end
    inventory.add(me(), "Silver", m.silver)
    active[m.id] = nil
    completed = completed + 1
    add_contribution(m.contrib)
    add_rep(m.rep)
    ui.set_text("Notification", "Mission complete\n" .. m.name .. ": " .. m.silver .. " silver, " .. m.contrib .. " contribution.")
    replace_offer(n)
    sound.play("coin handle")
    persist()
    board_render("Well done.")
  else
    board_render(m.text .. " (" .. progress_of(m) .. "/" .. m.n .. ")")
  end
end

-- ---- The journal
local function journal_text()
  local head = "Journal\ntabs|" .. tab .. "|Quests|Missions|Codex|Achievements"
  local lines = {}
  if tab == 1 then
    lines[#lines + 1] = journal_quests
    local w = side.wen
    if w then
      local text = ({ active = "Find Wen's cart by the old watchtower.", found = "Return to Wen with his cart.", done = "Returned Wen's cart." })[w] or ""
      lines[#lines + 1] = (w == "done" and "done" or "active") .. "|Wen's cart|" .. text
    end
  elseif tab == 2 then
    local name, nxt = rank_of()
    lines[#lines + 1] = "done|" .. name .. " · " .. contribution .. " contribution" .. (nxt and (" (next rank at " .. nxt[2] .. ")") or "") .. "|"
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("done|Standing: sect %d · village %d · bandits %d|", rep.sect, rep.village, rep.bandits)
    for id in pairs(active) do
      for _, m in ipairs(MISSIONS) do
        if m.id == id then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("active|%s (%d/%d)|%s", m.name, progress_of(m), m.n, m.text) end
      end
    end
    if next(active) == nil then lines[#lines + 1] = "todo|No mission taken|Ask the board in the Great Hall." end
  elseif tab == 3 then
    local last = codex_order[#codex_order]
    for _, id in ipairs(codex_order) do
      local c = CODEX[id]
      lines[#lines + 1] = (id == last and "active|" or "done|") .. c[1] .. "|" .. c[2]
    end
    if #codex_order == 0 then lines[1] = "todo|Nothing recorded yet|Explore the valley." end
  else
    local count = 0
    for _, a in ipairs(ACHIEVEMENTS) do
      if done[a[1]] then count = count + 1 end
      lines[#lines + 1] = (done[a[1]] and "done|" or "todo|") .. a[2] .. "|" .. a[3]
    end
    head = "Journal  " .. count .. "/" .. #ACHIEVEMENTS .. "\ntabs|4|Quests|Missions|Codex|Achievements"
  end
  return head .. "\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function refresh_journal() ui.set_text("Quest log", journal_text()) end

-- ---- Events
local function on_slain(name)
  kills = kills + 1
  stats.slain[name] = (stats.slain[name] or 0) + 1
  award("first_blood")
  if kills >= 10 then award("bandit_bane") end
  if name:find("Iron Fist") then award("slayer") codex("elder") end
  if name:find("Bandit") then rep.bandits = rep.bandits + 1 end
  for _, m in ipairs(MISSIONS) do
    if active[m.id] ~= nil and m.kind == "kill" and name:find(m.match) then active[m.id] = active[m.id] + 1 end
  end
  persist()
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "journal" then journal_quests = value
  elseif name == "slain" then on_slain(value)
  elseif name == "side" then local k, v = value:match("^(%w+)|(%w+)$") if k then side[k] = v end
  elseif name == "shrines" then
    shrines_found = tonumber(value) or 0
    if shrines_found >= 4 then award("pilgrim") end
  elseif name == "realm" then
    realm = tonumber(value) or realm
    if realm >= 2 then award("gathered") end
    if realm >= 3 then award("foundation") end
    if realm >= 4 then award("golden") end
  elseif name == "codex" then codex(value)
  elseif name == "award" then award(value)
  elseif name == "tip" then tip(value)
  elseif name == "brewed" then stats.brewed = stats.brewed + 1 award("alchemist") codex("alchemy")
  elseif name == "forged" then
    stats.forged = stats.forged + 1
    award("smith") codex("forge")
    for _, m in ipairs(MISSIONS) do if active[m.id] ~= nil and m.kind == "event" and m.event == "forged" then active[m.id] = (active[m.id] or 0) + 1 end end
  elseif name == "fished" then stats.fished = stats.fished + 1 award("angler") codex("lake")
  elseif name == "hunted" then stats.hunted = stats.hunted + 1 award("hunter")
  elseif name == "mined" then stats.mined = stats.mined + 1 award("stoneheart")
  elseif name == "dungeon" then award("delver")
  elseif name == "standing" then
    local r = rank_of()
    ui.set_text("Notification", "Standing\n" .. r .. ", " .. contribution .. " contribution")
  end
end

function on_ui(name, value)
  if name ~= "Quest log" then return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if value == "close" then ui.close("Quest log")
  elseif value:sub(1, 4) == "tab:" then tab = tonumber(value:sub(5)) or 1 refresh_journal() end
end

local NEAR_BOARD = { "Mission board" }

function on_start()
  me()
  load_state()
  discount_standing()
  tip("start")
  refresh_journal()
end

function on_tick(dt)
  tap_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  local p = me()
  if not p then return end
  if clock >= 0.5 then
    clock = 0
    refresh_journal()
    -- Tips and codex entries that depend on where you are.
    local function near(name, r) local d = distance_to(name) return d and d < r end
    if near("Village shrine", 22) then codex("village") end
    if near("Peak shrine", 14) then codex("peak") end
    if near("Iron Fist Elder", 25) then codex("elder") end
    if near("Merchant Lin", 10) then tip("shrine") end
    if near("Instructor Hua", 8) then tip("arts") end
    if near("Bandit Brawler", 24) then tip("fight") end
    if near("Spirit herb 1", 10) or near("Spirit herb 2", 10) or near("Spirit herb 3", 10) then tip("herb") end
    if near("Lake shore", 12) then tip("fish") codex("lake") end
    if near("Cave mouth", 30) then codex("cave") end
    if near("Spirit Vein 1", 8) or near("Spirit Vein 2", 8) or near("Spirit Vein 3", 8) or near("Spirit Vein 4", 8) then codex("vein") end
  end
  -- The board.
  if talking == "Mission board" then
    local n = talk_poll()
    if n then board_choose(n) end
  elseif not talking and nearest_within(NEAR_BOARD) then
    world.send(p, "prompt", "read the mission board")
    if tapped("interact") then
      start_talk("Mission board")
      board_render()
    end
  end
end

table.sort(ZH, function(a, b) return #a[1] > #b[1] end)

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-lang", LANG)
end

-- Conversation plumbing shared by the scripts that talk to the Player (the scene builder places it in front of them):
-- the Dialogue widget shows what is said and numbered choices; keys 1 to 3 pick one. While a conversation is open the
-- Player script sets its mana aside (the number keys are skill keys too).
TALK_RANGE = 3.6
talking = nil            -- the name of whoever is being talked to
local talk_player

function player_id() talk_player = talk_player or world.find("Player") return talk_player end

-- A tap counts once even when a slow frame runs several ticks.
local last_tap, tap_clock = {}, 0
function tap_tick(dt) tap_clock = tap_clock + dt end
function tapped(action)
  if input.action_pressed(action) and tap_clock - (last_tap[action] or -1) > 0.3 then
    last_tap[action] = tap_clock
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function say(speaker, line, choices)
  local text = speaker .. ": " .. line
  for _, c in ipairs(choices or {}) do text = text .. "\n> " .. c end
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", text)
end

function end_talk()
  if talking then
    talking = nil
    ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
    local p = player_id()
    if p then world.send(p, "talk", 0) end
  end
end

function start_talk(name)
  talking = name
  local p = player_id()
  if p then world.send(p, "talk", 1) end
end

-- The distance from the Player to a named entity, or nil.
function distance_to(name)
  local p, id = player_id(), world.find(name)
  if not p or not id then return nil end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(p)
  local x, _, z = world.position(id)
  return math.sqrt((px - x) ^ 2 + (pz - z) ^ 2)
end

-- The nearest of these names within talking range, or nil.
function nearest_within(names, range)
  local best, best_d = nil, (range or TALK_RANGE)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local d = distance_to(name)
    if d and d < best_d then best, best_d = name, d end
  end
  return best
end

-- Walking away ends a conversation; E ends it too. Returns the key (1 to 3) the Player picked, if any.
function talk_poll()
  if not talking then return nil end
  local d = distance_to(talking)
  if not d or d > TALK_RANGE + 2.5 then end_talk() return nil end
  if tapped("interact") then end_talk() return nil end
  for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
    if input.pressed(key) and tap_clock - (last_tap.pick or -1) > 0.3 then
      last_tap.pick = tap_clock
      return n
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- ---- Messages
function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "travel" then
    local pos, label = value:match("^([^|]+)|(.*)$")
    local x, y, z = pos:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)$")
    if x then
      ride = { x = tonumber(x), y = tonumber(y), z = tonumber(z), left = 0.8 }
      say_line("Riding\nTo " .. label)
      sound.play("cloth swish")
    end
  elseif name == "hours" then day_hours = tonumber(value) or day_hours
  elseif name == "rain" then rain = tonumber(value) or 0 sky.weather(rain, rain > 0 and 0.35 or 0.08, 1.5, 0.5)
  elseif name == "arrive" then
    local x, y, z, interior = value:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)|(.*)$")
    if x then arrive(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z), interior ~= "" and interior or nil) end
  end
end

-- ---- Ticks
local function door_tick()
  for _, d in ipairs(DOORS) do
    local dist = distance_to(d.door)
    if dist and dist < 2.4 then
      world.send(me(), "prompt", d.prompt)
      if tapped("interact") then
        local id = world.find(d.partner)
        if id then
          local x, y, z = world.position(id)
          arrive(x + d.dx, y + 1.1, z + d.dz, d.interior)
          sound.play("cloth swish")
          if d.interior == "Cave of Whispers" then world.send(world.find("Sect"), "codex", "cave") end
        end
      end
      return
    end
  end
end

  fish_cooldown = math.max(0, fish_cooldown - dt)
  local shore = distance_to("Lake shore")
  if not shore or shore > 3.2 then
    if fishing then fishing = nil say_line("Fishing\nYou step away from the water.") end
    return
  end
  if not fishing then
    if fish_cooldown <= 0 then
      world.send(me(), "prompt", "cast a line")
      if tapped("interact") then
        fishing = { stage = "wait", left = 2 + math.random() * 5 }
        say_line("Fishing\nThe line is out. Wait for a bite.")
        sound.play("cloth swish")
      end
    end
    return
  end
  fishing.left = fishing.left - dt
  if fishing.stage == "wait" then
    world.send(me(), "prompt", "wait for a bite...")
    if fishing.left <= 0 then
      fishing = { stage = "bite", left = 1.2 }
      say_line("Fishing\nA bite! Press E now.")
      sound.play("bell")
    end
    if tapped("interact") then fishing = nil say_line("Fishing\nYou reeled in too early.") fish_cooldown = 1 end
  else
    world.send(me(), "prompt", "reel in!")
    if tapped("interact") then
      local rare = math.random() < 0.08
      local item = rare and "Spirit Stone" or "Silver Carp"
      if inventory.space(me(), item) > 0 then
        inventory.add(me(), item, 1)
        say_line("Caught\n" .. (rare and "A spirit stone glints in the carp's mouth." or "A silver carp."))
        world.send(world.find("Sect"), "fished", "")
        sound.play("coin handle")
      else
        say_line("Fishing\nYou cannot carry more.")
      end
      fishing = nil
      fish_cooldown = 1.5
    elseif fishing.left <= 0 then
      fishing = nil
      fish_cooldown = 1.5
      say_line("Fishing\nIt got away.")
    end
  end
end

-- Things that happen when an item turns up in the bag: a spirit stone from the rock, venison from a kill.
local function watch_bag()
  for _, name in ipairs({ "Spirit Stone", "Raw Venison" }) do
    local n = inventory.count(me(), name)
    local before = last_counts[name]
    if before and n > before then
      if name == "Spirit Stone" then world.send(world.find("Sect"), "mined", "") end
      if name == "Raw Venison" then world.send(world.find("Sect"), "hunted", "") end
    end
    last_counts[name] = n
  end
end

local intro_open = false
-- The look of the character is chosen once, when the opening shots end (or are skipped with Enter or Space).
local function open_mirror()
  if not intro_open then return end
  intro_open = false
  world.send(world.find("Player"), "mirror", "1")
end

function on_start()
  me()
  local text = save.get("azure-cloud-sect-valley")
  if text and text ~= "" then
    local h = text:match("hours=([%d.]+)")
    if h then day_hours = tonumber(h) end
  elseif (tonumber(props.intro) or 1) > 0 then
    -- A new game opens on a few shots of the valley (Space or Enter skips them).
    after(1.5, function()
      hud.panels("0 38 108 > 0 8 74 | The Azure Cloud Sect keeps its hall above the clouds. | | 4.5\n"
        .. "-12 22 32 > -24 4 38 | Willow Village lives in its shadow. Farmers, a merchant, a stable. | | 4.5\n"
        .. "-6 18 -16 > -6 3 4 | Below, a bandit camp has closed the road. | | 4\n"
        .. "0 34 -52 > 0 10 -78 | And at the foot of Heaven Peak, a shrine, and the guardian who will not let you pass. | | 5")
    end)
    -- After the shots, the mirror: the look of the character is chosen before the first step.
    intro_open = true
    after(24, function() open_mirror() end)
  end
  if (tonumber(props.mirror) or 0) > 0 then after(1.5, function() world.send(world.find("Player"), "mirror", "1") end) end
  audio.ambience("wind", 0.4)
  -- Started inside a room (a test, a saved game): the lighting and sound follow.
  after(0.3, function()
    local x, y, z = world.position(me())
    if y > 20 then
      inside = z > 60 and "Cave of Whispers" or "Great Hall"
      world.send(me(), "inside", inside)
      audio.ambience("wind", 0.05)
      set_lighting()
    else
      sky.time_of_day(day_hours)
    end
  end)
end

function on_tick(dt)
  tap_tick(dt)
  if intro_open and (input.pressed("enter") or input.pressed("space")) then after(0.5, open_mirror) end
  clock = clock + dt
  if not me() then return end
  day_hours = (day_hours + dt * 24 / DAY_SECONDS) % 24
  world.set_clock(day_hours)
  weather_left = weather_left - dt
  if weather_left <= 0 then
    weather_left = 60 + math.random() * 90
    if not inside then
      rain = math.random() < 0.3 and 0.35 + math.random() * 0.3 or 0
      sky.weather(rain, rain > 0 and 0.35 or 0.08, 1.5, 0.5)
      audio.ambience("rain", rain)
    end
  end
  sky_clock = sky_clock + dt
  if sky_clock >= 2 then sky_clock = 0 set_lighting() end
  -- A ride: a short beat, then you are there (the clock moves on a little).
  if ride then
    ride.left = ride.left - dt
    if ride.left <= 0 then
      day_hours = (day_hours + 0.25) % 24
      arrive(ride.x, ride.y, ride.z, nil)
      ride = nil
    end
  end
  if not talking and not ride then
    door_tick()
    fishing_tick(dt)
  end
  if clock >= 1 then
    clock = 0
    watch_bag()
    world.send(me(), "hours", string.format("%.2f", day_hours))
    save.set("azure-cloud-sect-valley", string.format("hours=%.2f", day_hours))
  end
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-lang", LANG)
end

-- Conversation plumbing shared by the scripts that talk to the Player (the scene builder places it in front of them):
-- the Dialogue widget shows what is said and numbered choices; keys 1 to 3 pick one. While a conversation is open the
-- Player script sets its mana aside (the number keys are skill keys too).
TALK_RANGE = 3.6
talking = nil            -- the name of whoever is being talked to
local talk_player

function player_id() talk_player = talk_player or world.find("Player") return talk_player end

-- A tap counts once even when a slow frame runs several ticks.
local last_tap, tap_clock = {}, 0
function tap_tick(dt) tap_clock = tap_clock + dt end
function tapped(action)
  if input.action_pressed(action) and tap_clock - (last_tap[action] or -1) > 0.3 then
    last_tap[action] = tap_clock
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function say(speaker, line, choices)
  local text = speaker .. ": " .. line
  for _, c in ipairs(choices or {}) do text = text .. "\n> " .. c end
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", text)
end

function end_talk()
  if talking then
    talking = nil
    ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
    local p = player_id()
    if p then world.send(p, "talk", 0) end
  end
end

function start_talk(name)
  talking = name
  local p = player_id()
  if p then world.send(p, "talk", 1) end
end

-- The distance from the Player to a named entity, or nil.
function distance_to(name)
  local p, id = player_id(), world.find(name)
  if not p or not id then return nil end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(p)
  local x, _, z = world.position(id)
  return math.sqrt((px - x) ^ 2 + (pz - z) ^ 2)
end

-- The nearest of these names within talking range, or nil.
function nearest_within(names, range)
  local best, best_d = nil, (range or TALK_RANGE)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local d = distance_to(name)
    if d and d < best_d then best, best_d = name, d end
  end
  return best
end

-- Walking away ends a conversation; E ends it too. Returns the key (1 to 3) the Player picked, if any.
function talk_poll()
  if not talking then return nil end
  local d = distance_to(talking)
  if not d or d > TALK_RANGE + 2.5 then end_talk() return nil end
  if tapped("interact") then end_talk() return nil end
  for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
    if input.pressed(key) and tap_clock - (last_tap.pick or -1) > 0.3 then
      last_tap.pick = tap_clock
      return n
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- The people and shrines of the valley (the scene builder places items.lua and talk.lua in front of this): every
-- conversation that is not a shop. Instructor Hua teaches scroll arts and qi affinities, Wen has a lost cart, shrines save
-- and send you between each other, Stablemaster Gu rides you there and keeps a spirit fox, Disciple Lan joins your side.
-- The merchant, the furnace and the anvil open the Shop window instead.
local realm = 1
local arts = {}                 -- move -> true, once learned
local affinity = ""
local cart = nil                -- Wen's side quest: nil, "active", "found", "done"
local found = {}                -- shrine entity name -> true once visited
local node, sub = "root", 1
local travel_at = 1
local fox_owned = false
local lan_following = false
local clock = 0

local ARTS = {
  { move = "sword_qi",      name = "Sword Qi",      price = 80,  key = "5", info = "a crescent of sword light", realm = 2 },
  { move = "thunder_lance", name = "Thunder Lance", price = 140, key = "6", info = "a fast bolt that staggers", realm = 2 },
  { move = "flame_palm",    name = "Flame Palm",    price = 100, key = "7", info = "a fireball that sets foes alight", realm = 2 },
  { move = "guardian",      name = "Spirit Guardian", price = 260, key = "0", info = "calls a spirit warrior for 25 s", realm = 3 },
}
local AFFINITIES = {
  { id = "flame", name = "Flame", info = "your arts burn" },
  { id = "frost", name = "Frost", info = "your arts chill and slow" },
  { id = "thunder", name = "Thunder", info = "your arts stun" },
}
-- Where you can pray or ride to: the entity, what it is called, and where you stand when you arrive.
local SHRINES = {
  { entity = "Meditation altar", label = "the Sect altar" },
  { entity = "Wayside shrine", label = "the Wayside shrine" },
  { entity = "Village shrine", label = "Willow Village" },
  { entity = "Peak shrine", label = "Heaven Peak" },
}
local TALKERS = { "Instructor Hua", "Wen", "Stablemaster Gu", "Disciple Lan", "Wayside shrine", "Meditation altar", "Village shrine", "Peak shrine" }
local USERS = { ["Merchant Lin"] = "merchant", ["Alchemy furnace"] = "alchemy", Anvil = "forge" }
local PROMPT = { ["Merchant Lin"] = "trade with Merchant Lin", ["Alchemy furnace"] = "use the alchemy furnace", Anvil = "use the anvil",
  ["Wayside shrine"] = "pray at the wayside shrine", ["Meditation altar"] = "pray at the Sect altar", ["Village shrine"] = "pray at the village shrine", ["Peak shrine"] = "pray at the peak shrine" }

-- Folk's own saved state: shrines found, the side quest, the fox and Lan.
local function persist()
  local list = {}
  for entity in pairs(found) do list[#list + 1] = entity end
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-folk", string.format("found=%s;cart=%s;fox=%s;lan=%s", table.concat(list, ","), cart or "", fox_owned and "1" or "0", lan_following and "1" or "0"))
end

local function silver() return inventory.count(player_id(), "Silver") end
local function silver_note() return " You have " .. silver() .. " silver." end
local function is_shrine(name) return name:find("shrine") or name:find("altar") end

local function discovered()
  local list = {}
  for _, s in ipairs(SHRINES) do if found[s.entity] then list[#list + 1] = s end end
  return list
end

-- The conversation each name opens, and what its choices do.
local render, choose

function render(note)
  local name = talking
  if name == "Instructor Hua" then
    if node == "root" then
      say(name, note or "A scroll holds an art; the rest is practice. What would you like?", { "Scroll arts", "Qi affinity", "My standing in the sect" })
    elseif node == "arts" then
      if realm < 2 then say(name, "Qi arts need a body that holds qi. Come back as a Qi Gathering cultivator.", {}) return end
      local choices = {}
      local first = sub == 1 and 1 or 3
      for i = first, math.min(first + 1, #ARTS) do
        local a = ARTS[i]
        choices[#choices + 1] = arts[a.move] and (a.name .. ": learned, key " .. a.key)
          or (realm < a.realm and (a.name .. ": needs " .. (a.realm == 3 and "Foundation" or "Qi Gathering")) or (a.name .. " (" .. a.price .. "): " .. a.info))
      end
      choices[#choices + 1] = sub == 1 and "More arts..." or "Back to the first scrolls"
      say(name, note or ("Choose a scroll." .. silver_note()), choices)
    elseif node == "affinity" then
      local choices = {}
      for _, a in ipairs(AFFINITIES) do choices[#choices + 1] = a.name .. (affinity == a.id and " (yours)" or ": " .. a.info) end
      say(name, note or (affinity == "" and "Your qi leans one way. Name it." or "Your qi can lean another way, for 100 silver."), choices)
    elseif node == "standing" then
      say(name, note or "Walk the road and the sect will see it.", {})
    end
  elseif name == "Wen" then
    if cart == nil then say(name, "Bandits took my cart on the road. It was last seen near the old watchtower. Could you look?", { "I will look for it.", "Not now." })
    elseif cart == "active" then say(name, "Any sign of my cart?", { "Still looking." })
    elseif cart == "found" then say(name, "My cart! Thank you. Take this, it is all I have.", { "Accept the reward" })
    else say(name, "The valley is safer with you in it.", { "Farewell." }) end
  elseif name == "Stablemaster Gu" then
    if node == "root" then
      say(name, note or "A good horse covers the valley before the tea cools.", { "Ride to a shrine (10 silver)", fox_owned and "Send the spirit fox away" or "Adopt a spirit fox (150 silver)", "Leave" })
    elseif node == "travel" then
      local list = discovered()
      local dest = list[travel_at]
      say(name, note or (dest and ("To " .. dest.label .. ".") or "You have not found a shrine to ride to."), dest and { "Ride there (10 silver)", "Another place", "Back" } or { "Back" })
    end
  elseif name == "Disciple Lan" then
    say(name, note or (lan_following and "Lead on, senior. Meditate beside me and we will cultivate together." or "I could walk with you, if you like."), { lan_following and "Wait here." or "Walk with me.", "Spar with me", "Never mind" })
  elseif is_shrine(name) then
    if node == "root" then
      say(name, note or "A quiet place. Pray here to rest and make it your place of return, or ride on to another shrine.", { "Pray and rest", "Travel to another shrine", "Change appearance" })
    elseif node == "travel" then
      local list = discovered()
      local dest = list[travel_at]
      say(name, note or (dest and ("To " .. dest.label .. ".") or "No other shrine is known to you."), dest and { "Go there", "Another place", "Back" } or { "Back" })
    end
  end
end

local function travel_to(dest, price)
  if price and silver() < price then render("You need " .. price .. " silver.") return end
  if price then inventory.remove(player_id(), "Silver", price) end
  local id = world.find(dest.entity)
  if not id then return end
  local x, y, z = world.position(id)
  end_talk()
  world.send(world.find("Valley"), "travel", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f|%s", x + 2.5, y + 1.2, z + 2.5, dest.label))
end

function choose(n)
  local name = talking
  local p = player_id()
  if name == "Instructor Hua" then
    if node == "root" then
      if n == 1 then node, sub = "arts", 1 render()
      elseif n == 2 then node = "affinity" render()
      else node = "standing" world.send(world.find("Sect"), "standing", "") render("Ask the mission board in the Great Hall.") end
    elseif node == "arts" then
      if realm < 2 then end_talk() return end
      if n == 3 then sub = 3 - sub render() return end
      local a = ARTS[(sub == 1 and 0 or 2) + n]
      if not a then render() return end
      if arts[a.move] then render("You already know " .. a.name .. ": press " .. a.key .. ".")
      elseif realm < a.realm then render("You are not ready for it.")
      elseif silver() < a.price then render("The scroll costs " .. a.price .. " silver." .. silver_note())
      else
        inventory.remove(p, "Silver", a.price)
        arts[a.move] = true
        world.send(p, "learn_art", a.move)
        sound.play("book open")
        render("Well studied. Press " .. a.key .. " in a fight.")
      end
    elseif node == "affinity" then
      local a = AFFINITIES[n]
      if not a then return end
      if affinity == a.id then render("It already is.")
      elseif affinity ~= "" and silver() < 100 then render("Changing it costs 100 silver.")
      else
        if affinity ~= "" then inventory.remove(p, "Silver", 100) end
        affinity = a.id
        world.send(p, "affinity", a.id)
        sound.play("force field")
        render("Your qi is " .. a.name .. " now: " .. a.info .. ".")
      end
    end
  elseif name == "Wen" then
    if cart == nil and n == 1 then
      cart = "active"
      sound.play("book open")
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Side quest\nFind Wen's cart near the old watchtower.")
      world.send(world.find("Sect"), "side", "wen|active")
      persist()
      render()
    elseif cart == "found" and n == 1 then
      cart = "done"
      inventory.add(p, "Silver", 60)
      inventory.add(p, "Qi Elixir", 2)
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Side quest complete\n60 silver and 2 Qi Elixirs.")
      world.send(world.find("Sect"), "side", "wen|done")
      persist()
      render()
    else end_talk() end
  elseif name == "Stablemaster Gu" then
    if node == "root" then
      if n == 1 then node, travel_at = "travel", 1 render()
      elseif n == 2 then
        if fox_owned then
          fox_owned = false
          world.send(world.find("Spirit Fox"), "dismiss", "")
          persist()
          render("The fox trots off to the woods.")
        elseif silver() < 150 then render("A fox costs 150 silver." .. silver_note())
        else
          inventory.remove(p, "Silver", 150)
          fox_owned = true
          world.send(world.find("Spirit Fox"), "adopt", "")
          persist()
          sound.play("force field")
          render("She will follow you and sniff out herbs.")
        end
      else end_talk() end
    elseif node == "travel" then
      local list = discovered()
      if n == 1 and list[travel_at] then travel_to(list[travel_at], 10)
      elseif n == 2 and #list > 0 then travel_at = travel_at % #list + 1 render()
      else node = "root" render() end
    end
  elseif name == "Disciple Lan" then
    if n == 1 then
      lan_following = not lan_following
      persist()
      world.send(world.find("Disciple Lan"), lan_following and "follow" or "wait", "")
      render()
    elseif n == 2 then
      end_talk()
      world.send(world.find("Disciple Lan"), "spar", "")
    else end_talk() end
  elseif is_shrine(name) then
    if node == "root" then
      if n == 1 then
        local sx, sy, sz = world.position(world.find(name))
        world.send(p, "rest", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", sx + 2.2, sy + 1.2, sz + 2.2))
        render("Rested. This is now where you return.")
      elseif n == 2 then node, travel_at = "travel", 1 render()
      else end_talk() world.send(p, "mirror", "1") end
    elseif node == "travel" then
      local list = discovered()
      if n == 1 and list[travel_at] then travel_to(list[travel_at], nil)
      elseif n == 2 and #list > 0 then travel_at = travel_at % #list + 1 render()
      else node = "root" render() end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  if name == "realm" then realm = tonumber(value) or realm
  elseif name == "arts" then for move in tostring(value):gmatch("[^,]+") do arts[move] = true end
  elseif name == "affinity" then affinity = tostring(value)
  elseif name == "fox" then fox_owned = value == "1"
  elseif name == "cart" then cart = value ~= "" and tostring(value) or nil
  elseif name == "found" then for entity in tostring(value):gmatch("[^,]+") do found[entity] = true end end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  tap_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  local p = player_id()
  if not p then return end
  -- Dual cultivation: Lan at your side, close enough, shares your meditation (the Player reads this flag).
  partner_clock = (partner_clock or 0) - dt
  if partner_clock <= 0 then
    partner_clock = 0.5
    local d = lan_following and distance_to("Disciple Lan") or nil
    world.send(p, "partner", (d and d < 4) and "1" or "0")
  end
  -- The cart is found by walking up to it.
  if cart == "active" then
    local d = distance_to("Lost Cart")
    if d and d < 5 then
      cart = "found"
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Side quest\nYou found Wen's cart. Return to him.")
      world.send(world.find("Sect"), "side", "wen|found")
      persist()
    end
  end
  -- Shrines you have been near can be travelled to.
  if clock >= 1 then
    clock = 0
    local fresh = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(SHRINES) do
      local d = distance_to(s.entity)
      if d and d < 12 and not found[s.entity] then
        found[s.entity] = true
        fresh[#fresh + 1] = s.entity
        if s.entity ~= "Meditation altar" then ui.set_text("Notification", "Shrine found\n" .. s.label) end
      end
    end
    if #fresh > 0 then world.send(world.find("Sect"), "shrines", tostring(#discovered())) persist() end
  end
  if talking then
    local n = talk_poll()
    if n then choose(n) end
    return
  end
  -- What E would do here (the Player script shows it), and doing it.
  local near = nearest_within(TALKERS)
  local user = nearest_within({ "Merchant Lin", "Alchemy furnace", "Anvil" })
  local target = near or user
  local label
  if target then
    label = PROMPT[target] or ("talk to " .. target)
    world.send(p, "prompt", label)
  end
  if target and tapped("interact") then
    if USERS[target] then world.send(world.find("Economy"), "open", USERS[target])
    else
      start_talk(target)
      node, sub = "root", 1
      if target == "Wen" or target == "Disciple Lan" then node = "root" end
      render()
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  local text = save.get("azure-cloud-sect-folk")
  if not text or text == "" then return end
  local f = {}
  for k, v in text:gmatch("(%w+)=([^;]*)") do f[k] = v end
  for entity in (f.found or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do found[entity] = true end
  cart = f.cart ~= "" and f.cart or nil
  fox_owned = f.fox == "1"
  lan_following = f.lan == "1"
  after(0.5, function()
    if fox_owned then world.send(world.find("Spirit Fox"), "adopt", "") end
    if lan_following then world.send(world.find("Disciple Lan"), "follow", "") end
    if cart then world.send(world.find("Sect"), "side", "wen|" .. cart) end
  end)
end

end

-- @prop kind fox
-- Followers. "fox": a spirit fox that trots after you once adopted and points out herbs; "lan": Disciple Lan, a fighter at
-- your side when asked; "guardian": a spirit warrior called by the Spirit Guardian art, gone after 25 seconds.
local player
local active = false
local home
local clock = 0
local life = 25
local scent_id
local cool = 0

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end

function on_start()
  home = { self.x, self.y, self.z }
  if props.kind == "guardian" then
    active = true
    after(0.2, function() if me() then melee.follow(me(), 1) end end)
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "adopt" or name == "follow" then
    active = true
    if props.kind == "lan" and me() then melee.follow(me(), 0) end
  elseif name == "dismiss" or name == "wait" then
    active = false
    if props.kind == "lan" then melee.follow() end
    ui.clear_marker("Herb scent")
  elseif name == "spar" and props.kind == "lan" then
    hud.announce("Disciple Lan: A good lesson! Keep your guard higher.")
    if me() then world.send(me(), "qi", 15) end
  end
end

function on_death()
  if props.kind == "lan" then
    after(8, function() melee.revive() if me() then local x, y, z = world.position(me()) world.set_position(self.id, x + 2, y + 1, z) end end)
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if props.kind == "guardian" then
    life = life - dt
    if life <= 0 then world.destroy(self.id) end
    return
  end
  if props.kind == "lan" then return end
  -- The fox.
  if not active or not me() then return end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(me())
  local dx, dz = px - self.x, pz - self.z
  local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
  if d > 40 then world.set_position(self.id, px + 2, self.y + 1, pz + 2) return end
  if d > 3.4 then
    local speed = d > 10 and 7.5 or 4.5
    world.set_velocity(self.id, dx / d * speed, self.vy or 0, dz / d * speed)
  else
    world.set_velocity(self.id, 0, self.vy or 0, 0)
  end
  clock = clock + dt
  if clock >= 1.5 then
    clock = 0
    -- It smells herbs: a marker on the nearest one within sixteen metres.
    local best, best_d, bx, by, bz = nil, 16, 0, 0, 0
    for i = 1, 16 do
      local id = world.find("Spirit herb " .. i)
      if id and world.alive(id) then
        local x, y, z = world.position(id)
        local dist = math.sqrt((x - px) ^ 2 + (z - pz) ^ 2)
        if dist < best_d then best, best_d, bx, by, bz = i, dist, x, y, z end
      end
    end
    if best then ui.marker("Herb scent", bx, by + 1.5, bz, "Herb") else ui.clear_marker("Herb scent") end
  end
end

-- @prop kind fox
-- Followers. "fox": a spirit fox that trots after you once adopted and points out herbs; "lan": Disciple Lan, a fighter at
-- your side when asked; "guardian": a spirit warrior called by the Spirit Guardian art, gone after 25 seconds.
local player
local active = false
local home
local clock = 0
local life = 25
local scent_id
local cool = 0

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end

function on_start()
  home = { self.x, self.y, self.z }
  if props.kind == "guardian" then
    active = true
    after(0.2, function() if me() then melee.follow(me(), 1) end end)
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "adopt" or name == "follow" then
    active = true
    if props.kind == "lan" and me() then melee.follow(me(), 0) end
  elseif name == "dismiss" or name == "wait" then
    active = false
    if props.kind == "lan" then melee.follow() end
    ui.clear_marker("Herb scent")
  elseif name == "spar" and props.kind == "lan" then
    hud.announce("Disciple Lan: A good lesson! Keep your guard higher.")
    if me() then world.send(me(), "qi", 15) end
  end
end

function on_death()
  if props.kind == "lan" then
    after(8, function() melee.revive() if me() then local x, y, z = world.position(me()) world.set_position(self.id, x + 2, y + 1, z) end end)
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if props.kind == "guardian" then
    life = life - dt
    if life <= 0 then world.destroy(self.id) end
    return
  end
  if props.kind == "lan" then return end
  -- The fox.
  if not active or not me() then return end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(me())
  local dx, dz = px - self.x, pz - self.z
  local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
  if d > 40 then world.set_position(self.id, px + 2, self.y + 1, pz + 2) return end
  if d > 3.4 then
    local speed = d > 10 and 7.5 or 4.5
    world.set_velocity(self.id, dx / d * speed, self.vy or 0, dz / d * speed)
  else
    world.set_velocity(self.id, 0, self.vy or 0, 0)
  end
  clock = clock + dt
  if clock >= 1.5 then
    clock = 0
    -- It smells herbs: a marker on the nearest one within sixteen metres.
    local best, best_d, bx, by, bz = nil, 16, 0, 0, 0
    for i = 1, 16 do
      local id = world.find("Spirit herb " .. i)
      if id and world.alive(id) then
        local x, y, z = world.position(id)
        local dist = math.sqrt((x - px) ^ 2 + (z - pz) ^ 2)
        if dist < best_d then best, best_d, bx, by, bz = i, dist, x, y, z end
      end
    end
    if best then ui.marker("Herb scent", bx, by + 1.5, bz, "Herb") else ui.clear_marker("Herb scent") end
  end
end

-- @prop kind deer
-- Animals you can hunt: a deer gives raw venison and a hide; a wolf (it chases on its own) gives a pelt, qi and trouble.
function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local kind = props.kind or "deer"
  if kind == "deer" then
    inventory.add(player, "Raw Venison", math.random(1, 2))

  else

    world.send(player, "kill", 18)
    world.send(player, "slain", "Wolf")
  end
end

-- A crate, barrel or jar: it breaks when struck and may hold something (props.loot: "Item:chance Item:chance").
function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if player then
    for item, chance in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("([%w ]+):([%d.]+)") do

        hud.announce("You find a " .. item .. ".")

    end
  end
  sound.play("metal hit")
  after(0.05, function() world.destroy(self.id) end)
end

-- @prop gear none
-- A sect disciple at practice: it fights its sparring partner and cannot be hurt; when the Player comes near it stops and
-- stands easy, and carries on once they leave.
local resting = false
local clock = 0

function on_damaged()
  world.heal(self.id, 9999)
end

function on_start()
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  if clock < 0.5 then return end
  clock = 0
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(player)
  local near = (px - self.x) ^ 2 + (pz - self.z) ^ 2 < 7 * 7
  if near and not resting then resting = true melee.set_ai(false)
  elseif not near and resting then resting = false melee.set_ai(true) end
end

-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if n:find("^Bandit") then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  if alert_left <= 0 and (world.name(self.id) or ""):find("^Bandit") then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(1 + 0.3 * phase, 1 + 0.08 * phase, -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")

          local ang = k * math.pi + phase

        end
      end
    end
  end
end

  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

Script.source:
-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if n:find("^Bandit") then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  if alert_left <= 0 and (world.name(self.id) or ""):find("^Bandit") then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(1 + 0.3 * phase, 1 + 0.08 * phase, -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

-- @prop kind deer
-- Animals you can hunt: a deer gives raw venison and a hide; a wolf (it chases on its own) gives a pelt, qi and trouble.
function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local kind = props.kind or "deer"
  if kind == "deer" then
    inventory.add(player, "Raw Venison", math.random(1, 2))
    inventory.add(player, "Deer Hide", 1)
    hud.announce("You skin the deer.")
  else
    inventory.add(player, "Wolf Pelt", 1)
    world.send(player, "kill", 18)
    world.send(player, "slain", "Wolf")
  end
end

table.sort(ZH, function(a, b) return #a[1] > #b[1] end)

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("azure-cloud-sect-lang", LANG)
end

-- ---- Afflictions from enemy blows: poison, bleeding and burning drain health; a curse weakens your blows; chill slows them.
local AFFLICTIONS = {
  poison = { label = "Poison", dps = 2.5, cure = true }, bleed = { label = "Bleeding", dps = 3.5, cure = true },
  burn = { label = "Burning", dps = 4, cure = true }, curse = { label = "Cursed", cure = true }, chill = { label = "Chilled", cure = true },
}
local function effect_mod(name, on, off) return effects[name] and on or off end

local function apply_realm(first)
  local r = REALMS[realm]
  melee.tune(r.damage * (1 + 0.05 * (stage - 1)) * (1 + total_of("dmg")) * effect_mod("curse", 0.75, 1),
    r.speed * (1 + total_of("speed")) * effect_mod("chill", 0.8, 1), r.crit + total_of("crit"), -1,
    r.health * (1 + total_of("hp")), r.mana * (1 + total_of("mana")))
  for move in r.unlock:gmatch("[%w_]+") do melee.unlock(move) end
  if not first then world.heal(self.id, r.health) end
  send("Folk", "realm", realm)
  send("Sect", "realm", realm)
end

local function afflict(name, secs)
  if not AFFLICTIONS[name] then return end
  local had = effects[name]
  effects[name] = { left = secs, max = math.max(secs, had and had.max or 0) }
  if not had and (name == "curse" or name == "chill") then apply_realm(true) end
end
local function cure(all)
  local changed = false
  for name, def in pairs(AFFLICTIONS) do
    if effects[name] and (all or def.cure) then
      effects[name] = nil
      if name == "curse" or name == "chill" then changed = true end
    end
  end
  if changed then apply_realm(true) end
end

local function status_text()
  local r = REALMS[realm]
  local out = {}
  if channel > 0 then out[#out + 1] = string.format("Breaking through|%.1f|good|%d", channel, CHANNEL) end
  if not talking_now and prompt_left > 0 then out[#out + 1] = "Press E: " .. prompt_text .. "|0|good" end
  if tribulation > 0 then out[#out + 1] = string.format("Heavenly tribulation: keep moving|%.0f|bad|%d", tribulation, TRIBULATION) end
  if meditating then out[#out + 1] = (in_vein and "Meditating at a spirit vein: x3|0|good") or (formation and "Meditating in an array: x2|0|good") or (partner and "Dual cultivation with Lan: x1.8|0|good") or "Meditating|0|good" end
  if flying then out[#out + 1] = "Flying sword|0|good" end
  for name, e in pairs(effects) do out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s|%.0f|bad|%.0f", AFFLICTIONS[name].label, e.left, e.max) end
  if ward then out[#out + 1] = string.format("Ward: %d|%.0f|good|20", ward.absorb, ward.left) end
  if formation then out[#out + 1] = string.format("Qi array|%.0f|good|120", formation.left) end
  if stance ~= "fists" then out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s stance|0|good", STANCE_LABEL[stance]) end
  if deviation > 0 then out[#out + 1] = string.format("Qi deviation|%.0f|bad|12", deviation) end
  if realm < #REALMS and qi >= r.need and channel <= 0 and tribulation <= 0 then
    out[#out + 1] = inventory.count(self.id, "Breakthrough Pill") > 0 and "Qi is full: press B|0|good" or "Qi is full: needs a Breakthrough Pill|0|neutral"
  end
  return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
